1.stem_plain: Last Sunday, Sam __________ to the park with his family.

2.stem_plain: My parents __________ pleased when they heard the good news.

3.stem_plain: While I __________ a book, the doorbell rang.

4.stem_plain: After doing the chores yesterday, my sister __________ tired.

5.stem_plain: The children played a game of hide-and-seek __________ recess.

6.stem_plain: __________ shelves over there have not been dusted yet.

7.stem_plain: Henry went to the playground __________ he had completed his homework.

8.stem_plain: "Mrs Tan __________ us our groups for the project right now," Brad told George.

9.stem_plain: The dish was very spicy as she had added too __________ pepper to it.

10.stem_plain: This stall is very popular, so there are __________ customers who visit it.

1.note: “Last Sunday”（上个星期天）明确表示过去的时间，因此动词需要使用一般过去时 went。
1.concept: 一般过去时 — Simple Past Tense
1.zh: 上个星期天，山姆和他的家人一起去了公园。

2.note: 主语 “My parents”（我的父母）是复数，且从句中的 heard 提示事情发生在过去，因此动词使用复数过去式 were。
2.concept: 主谓一致与过去时 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Past Tense
2.zh: 当听到这个好消息时，我的父母很高兴。

3.note: “While” 引导的时间状语从句通常表示一个过去正在持续进行的动作，因此主句动词使用过去进行时 was reading。
3.concept: 过去进行时 — Past Continuous Tense
3.zh: 当我正在看书的时候，门铃响了。

4.note: “yesterday”（昨天）提示过去时间，主语 “my sister” 是单数，因此系动词用单数过去式 was。
4.concept: 系动词过去时 — Past Tense of 'be'
4.zh: 昨天做完家务后，我的姐姐/妹妹感到很累。

5.note: “during” 表示“在……期间”，后面常接表示一段时间的名词，符合在课间休息期间玩游戏的情境。
5.concept: 时间介词 — Prepositions of Time — during
5.zh: 孩子们在课间休息时玩了捉迷藏游戏。

6.note: “shelves” 是复数名词，且 “over there”（在那边）表示空间上较远，因此要选用表示远称复数的指示代词 Those。
6.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — Those
6.zh: 那边的架子还没有除尘。

7.note: “since” 在这里作连词，表示“因为，由于”，用来引导原因状语从句，解释亨利去操场的原因。
7.concept: 原因连词 — Conjunctions of Reason — since
7.zh: 亨利去了操场，因为他已经完成了作业。

8.note: “right now”（现在，此刻）明确提示动作正在进行，因此动词使用现在进行时 is assigning。
8.concept: 现在进行时 — Present Continuous Tense
8.zh: “陈老师现在正在给我们分配项目小组，”布拉德告诉乔治。

9.note: “pepper”（胡椒粉）在这里是不可数名词，表示“太多”时要用 “too much” 来修饰。
9.concept: 不可数名词修饰语 — Quantifiers with Uncountable Nouns — too much
9.zh: 这道菜非常辣，因为她放了太多的胡椒粉。

10.note: 摊位“很受欢迎”（very popular）意味着顾客很多，“customers” 是可数名词复数，因此选用 many。
10.concept: 可数名词修饰语 — Quantifiers with Countable Nouns — many
10.zh: 这个摊位很受欢迎，所以有很多顾客光顾。

11.stem_plain: The museum contained many precious __________ from all over the world.

12.stem_plain: The mischievous boys were __________ and bowed their heads after being caught red-handed vandalising.

13.stem_plain: The elderly man __________ slowly along the pavement while carrying a heavy grocery bag.

14.stem_plain: The actors rehearsed for their performance __________ over many months, turning up every day without fail.

15.stem_plain: My pet dog __________ in fear after thunder boomed during the rainstorm.

11.zh: 这家博物馆藏有许多来自世界各地的珍贵展品。
11.note: “exhibits” 意为“展品、陈列品”，与前面的 “museum”（博物馆）构成直接的语境搭配。
11.concept: 名词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — exhibits

choices.eg: Visitors are requested not to touch any of the ancient **exhibits** in the gallery.
The rescue team brought medical **supplies** and food to the earthquake victims.
This dairy farm manufactures high-quality milk **products** for the local market.
Please make sure you have all your personal **belongings** before leaving the train.

12.zh: 那些淘气的男孩在当场抓到搞破坏后感到羞愧，并低下了头。
12.note: “bowed their heads”（低下头）以及被当场抓住（caught red-handed）表明他们认错反省，因此选用形容词 “ashamed”（羞愧的）。
12.concept: 形容词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Adjectives) — ashamed

choices.eg: She felt immensely **relieved** when she found her missing passport in her drawer.
No one liked the new champion because he was extremely **arrogant** about his success.
The little boy was **reluctant** to share his favorite toys with his cousin.
He felt **ashamed** of his rude behavior and immediately apologized to his teacher.

13.zh: 这位老人在提着沉重的购物袋时，在人行道上缓缓地拖着脚步走。
13.note: “shuffled” 意为“拖着脚走、蹒跚而行”，常用来形容长者或身体疲惫、负重前行时脚步沉重、不抬脚的走路姿态。
13.concept: 动词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — shuffled

choices.zh: 大摇大摆地走，昂首阔步
choices.eg: The peacock **strutted** around the courtyard, showing off its colorful feathers.
The sleepy children **shuffled** into the kitchen in their slippers.
He **stumbled** over a hidden tree root and nearly dropped his camera.
The tourists **sauntered** along the beach, enjoying the beautiful sunset.

14.zh: 演员们连续几个月不知疲倦地为演出彩排，每天都准时到场，从不缺席。
14.note: “turning up every day without fail”（每天准时到场从不缺席）以及长达数月（over many months）的坚持，最贴切的修饰词是 “tirelessly”（不知疲倦地）。
14.concept: 副词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Adverbs) — tirelessly

choices.eg: The doctor **patiently** explained the treatment process to the nervous patient.

choices.zh: 不知疲倦地，勤勤恳恳地
choices.eg: The volunteers worked **tirelessly** to clear the debris after the storm.
She greeted everyone **cheerfully** as she walked into the office this morning.
The professional gymnast **effortlessly** completed the complex routine.

15.zh: 暴风雨中雷声隆隆，我的宠物狗吓得呜呜低叫。
15.note: “whimpered” 意为“（因恐惧、痛苦等）低声呜咽、抽泣”，最符合狗在受到雷声惊吓（in fear）时的本能反应。
15.concept: 拟声词/动词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — whimpered

choices.zh: 呜咽，抽泣（常指动物或小孩因害怕发出的声音）
choices.eg: The injured puppy **whimpered** softly until the vet arrived to treat it.

choices.zh: 发出尖锐刺耳的声音，尖叫
choices.eg: The car brakes **screeched** loudly as the driver stopped suddenly.
The passengers **grumbled** about the long flight delay at the airport.
She happily **hummed** a catchy tune while preparing dinner in the kitchen.

21.note: 解释为什么选这个答案 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.

17.note: 指代珍妮（Jenny）的生日。Jenny是女性，故使用女性形容词性物主代词“her”（她的）。

18.note: 指代李先生（Mr Lee）的眼睛亮了起来。Mr Lee是男性，故使用男性形容词性物主代词“his”（他的）。

19.note: 指代爱上的对象“小猫（kitten）”。在英语中，动物作动词短语fell in love with的宾语时，通常用代词宾格“it”（它）。

20.note: 指代珍妮和小猫共同建立的“新纽带/亲密关系”。因为是两者的共同关系，故使用复数形容词性物主代词“their”（它们的/他们的）。

cloze: Mr Lee had promised to get a kitten for Jenny’s birthday. Jenny eagerly waited for [Q17] birthday to arrive. After visiting several pet adoption centres, Mr Lee eventually decided on a white kitten. [Q18] eyes lit up upon seeing its cute face. On Jenny’s birthday, Mr Lee presented the kitten to Jenny. She fell in love with [Q19] immediately and looked forward to [Q20] new bond.
They soon became the best of friends.
zh: 李先生答应在珍妮生日时送她一只小猫。珍妮热切地等待着她的生日到来。在参观了几家宠物领养中心后，李先生最终决定选一只白色的小猫。看到它可爱的脸，李先生的眼睛亮了起来。在珍妮生日那天，李先生把小猫送给了珍妮。她立刻爱上了它，并期待着它们之间建立的新纽带。
它们很快成为了最好的朋友。

cloze: Prototype editing cloze: The sun lend me a [Q46(hend)] when I am down.

46.note: 完美契合经典口语及书面语习语 lend a hand，表示在需要时“伸出援手”或“搭把手”提供帮助。

25.note: 与 new skills 搭配，表示“学习”或“掌握”新技能，符合语境。

26.note: connect with someone 为固定搭配，表示“与某人建立联系/交流”。

27.note: many 后面接可数名词复数，many types/kinds of... 表示“许多种类的……”。

28.note: 位于句首引导方式或途径，表示“通过”诸如绘画等活动。

29.concept: 形容词与名词固定搭配
29.note: vivid imagination 为英语中的常用固定搭配，意为“丰富的想象力”。

30.concept: 形容词并列与上下文语境
30.note: 与 physically active（身体活跃）由 and 并列，且下文提到“减少看医生的次数”，说明是保持“健康”。

31.note: 与 weak literacy skills（较弱的读写能力）搭配，表示“提高”或“改善”这种能力。

32.note: cope with 为固定短语，表示“应付/应对”，在此处指“应对学业”。

cloze: Hobbies play an important part in children's growth. They can help children explore their interests, unleash their creativity and [Q25(learn)] new skills. They also create opportunities for children to connect [Q26(with)] their peers. There are many [Q27(types)] of hobbies for children to choose from, depending on their interests.

Some children excel at creating things with their hands. [Q28(Through)] activities such as drawing and painting, they are able to express their thoughts and ideas using paper and other materials. Arts and crafts allow children with vivid [Q29(imagination)] to display their talents.

Sports also make good hobbies for children. They keep children physically active and [Q30(healthy)], reducing the need for regular visits to the doctor. In addition, sports teach values such as perseverance and teamwork.

Hobbies like reading and writing can [Q31(improve)] children's weak literacy skills. Such hobbies benefit children's learning and will help them to [Q32(cope)] with their studies. They can pick up new vocabulary and ideas from stories that they read or write.
Parents can support their children in exploring hobbies by offering guidance and encouragement to find activities that match their interests and talents.
zh: 爱好在儿童的成长过程中扮演着重要角色。它们可以帮助儿童探索自己的兴趣，释放创造力并学习新技能。它们还为儿童创造了与同伴联系的机会。有许多种类的爱好供儿童根据自己的兴趣进行选择。
有些儿童擅长用手创造东西。通过画画和涂色等活动，他们能够使用纸张和其他材料来表达自己的想法和创意。工艺美术让拥有丰富想象力的儿童得以展示他们的才华。
体育运动也是儿童很好的爱好。它们让儿童保持身体活跃和健康，从而减少定期看医生的需要。此外，体育运动还传授诸如坚持和团队合作等价值观。
阅读和写作等爱好可以提高儿童较弱的读写能力。这些爱好有益于儿童的学习，并能帮助他们应对学业。他们可以从阅读或写作的故事中汲取新的词汇和想法。
家长可以通过提供指导和鼓励来支持孩子们探索爱好，从而找到与他们的兴趣和才能相匹配之活动。

66.cue: It was raining. We stayed indoors. (so)

62.concept: 虚拟语气 — Conditional → Prepositional phrase ('Without + N')
62.zh: 没有教练的鼓励，我们本会在半途放弃。
62.note: 条件改写： If the coach had not encouraged …Without the coach's encouragement；主句 would have given up halfway 不变。
62.answer: Without the coach's encouragement, we would have given up halfway.
